name: Girgashites
overview: The Girgashites are identified in Scripture as one of the seven nations inhabiting the land promised by God to Abraham and his descendants, alongside the Amorites, Canaanites, and others (Genesis 15:21; Nehemiah 9:8). God delivered this land to the children of Israel, driving out these nations as a demonstration of His faithfulness and sovereignty (Deuteronomy 7:1; Joshua 3:10; Joshua 24:11). Their presence and subsequent removal highlight God's fulfillment of His covenant to give the promised inheritance to His people.
